meta.name: Exact · general ℓp norms
meta.regime: Exact search CVP for every fixed 1 < p < ∞, target in the lattice span
meta.rules: For each fixed 1 < p < ∞ return a closest vector in an arbitrary full-rank rational n-dimensional lattice under ℓp distance. The target lies in the span of the lattice. Count arithmetic operations, with polynomial input-size factors separated. Preserve p-dependence and bit-size/space guarantees. Euclidean-only algorithms do not solve this whole norm-family contract.
